about.title: YSK Limited
about.lede: YSK Limited is a Hong Kong company. YSK Mint is a browser app: it reads public chain data, holds no keys, and runs with no YSK backend server.

sections.title: Nature of the service
sections.body: YSK Mint is a browser interface operated in connection with YSK Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong. The app has no YSK backend server, takes no custody of assets, and does not create wallets. It reads public blockchain nodes and third-party protocol endpoints, and it may ask your wallet to sign transactions that you initiate. YSK Limited is not a broker, dealer, exchange, bank, money services business, investment adviser, or fiduciary.

sections.title: No advice
sections.body: Nothing on this site is investment, legal, tax, accounting, or other professional advice. Listings, prices, APY, depth, health scores, labels, and other figures are not recommendations to buy, sell, hold, lend, borrow, or launch any asset. You are solely responsible for your decisions and for taking independent professional advice where appropriate.

sections.title: Data and quotes
sections.body: Prices, reserves, depth, APY, utilization, balances, and activity are derived from public chain state and third-party protocol interfaces. They may be delayed, incomplete, inconsistent across venues, or wrong. Stablecoin marks (including USDC, USDT, USDM, and USDA) may be treated as one US dollar for display only. That treatment is not a guarantee of peg, redeemability, or solvency. YSK Limited does not warrant that any figure is current, complete, or fit for any purpose.

sections.title: Incomplete coverage
sections.body: Not every chain, DEX, lending market, pool, or token is listed. Absence from the app does not mean an asset is safe. Presence does not mean it is endorsed, audited, liquid, or lawful for you. Protocols can change, pause, or disappear without notice to YSK Limited.

sections.title: Tokens, pools, and protocols
sections.body: Tokens and smart contracts can be illiquid, exploited, upgradeable, pausable, taxed, inflated, or fraudulent. A ticker, icon, or name can be copied. You must verify contract addresses, networks, and counterparties yourself. Past prices and rates are not a guide to the future.

sections.title: Unaudited contracts
sections.body: Launch, lock, liquidity, and related contracts made available through YSK Mint may be unaudited and may contain errors. Test networks and main networks can fail. You use them entirely at your own risk.

sections.title: No custody; keys stay with you
sections.body: YSK Limited does not hold your private keys, seed phrases, or assets. Connecting a wallet or pasting an address does not create an account with us. If you sign a transaction, you authorize it. On-chain actions are typically irreversible. Lost keys, wrong networks, wrong addresses, and phishing are your risk.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: The app relies on wallet software, public RPC nodes (including nodes you configure), block explorers, naming services, DEX and lending protocols, and other third parties. YSK Limited does not control them and is not responsible for their availability, fees, errors, downtime, censorship, or security. Querying a public node or explorer may disclose addresses you look up.
